text.en:
Organization. The DFA Regional Consular Offices shall be
manned by Home Office-based personnel and locally hired employees from the
Region. It shall be headed by a ranking Officer of the Department.
PORA@Hologram # 45577

. 2

Staff House. Each Regional Consular Office is duly
authorized to rent a staff house for its Home Office based personnel, preferably
in the same building or premises where the Office is situated.

Funding. Funding for the Regional Consular Offices shall
come from the annual budget of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Passport
Revolving Fund. For the Calendar Year 2008, an initial fund amounting to Sixty-
Six Million Pesos (P66,000,000.00) shall be released from any available
appropriation for CY 2008, as may be determined by the Department of Budget
and Management.

Additional Guidelines. The Secretary of Foreign Affairs is
hereby directed to formulate additional implementing guidelines that may be
necessary to effect this Order. Provided, that all provisions and guidelines that
have financial implications are properly coordinated with the Secretary of Budget
and Management.

Effectivity.
- This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately after publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28th day of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
